hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880417 (the 22 Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp, water and sewer; 6 Modern Electric sites list 30-amp), https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ricketts-glen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880417, read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: '120 tent and trailer campsites' with gravel parking spurs. The booking site lists 131 campsites in the Big and Small loops (102 Modern Non-Electric, 22 Full-Hookup, 6 Modern Electric, 1 tent-only) besides cabins, deluxe cottages and group tenting. Listed max vehicle lengths are 15-30 ft at most sites, 40-45 ft at about 18; the Small-loop full-hookup sites run to 60-80 ft and five of them are pull-through.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ricketts-glen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880417 (site list and each site's details page) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Beginning in 2027 the shower houses are being replaced in phases; parts of the campground close while others stay open, and affected sites are blocked from reservation (DCNR/ReserveAmerica alert, read 2026-10-20).

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ricketts-glen-state-park/stay ('Hot showers, Flush toilets, Shaded sites, Gravel parking spurs, Sanitary dump station') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities and alerts for parkId 880417 ('Food Concession/Store Available In The Campground', Campground Rehabilitation Project Update), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ricketts-glen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880417 (Booking Window for Full-Hookup, Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric, Modern Tent Only: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (April-December, a few sites year-round) already manual and matches DCNR. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 22 full-hookup sites, 131 campsites (mostly 15-30 ft, full-hookups to 80 ft, five pull-throughs), hot showers, flush toilets, dump, camp store, and the 2027 phased shower-house renovation as a facilities note. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
